findings.title: Preserve the native rational rate before strict-right cropping
findings.body: Converting a rounded floating rate into an exact decimal fraction can include a sample exactly at the deadline. For a miniSEED factor/multiplier rate of 100/3 Hz, the floating value is 33.333333333333336. With start=0 and deadline=6*NS, this calculation makes stop=ceil(200.000000000000016)=201, including sample index 200 whose native time is exactly 6 seconds. A nonfinite or extreme boundary sample can consequently change an earlier horizon's qualification. Preserve the original rational rate or sample period through decoding and use it consistently for cropping and alignment.

findings.title: Propagate ResourceStop from header validation
findings.body: The generic exception handler catches ResourceStop raised by backend.headers() or backend.declared(), because ResourceStop inherits from RuntimeError. It records that interruption as a header error; decode() subsequently raises ValueError, and qualification_batch converts it into unresolved_engineering while continuing the replay. This violates the documented requirement that resource interruptions stop replay incomplete. Add an explicit ResourceStop propagation branch before recording ordinary header failures.

findings.title: Validate timezone offset components before datetime normalization
findings.body: The regex permits offset minutes from 00 through 99, and datetime.fromisoformat normalizes overflowing offset minutes rather than rejecting them. For example, +00:60 is interpreted as +01:00. A malformed StationXML epoch timestamp therefore receives a usable bound instead of a timestamp_errors entry and can pass epoch qualification. Validate the offset component ranges explicitly before conversion so invalid timestamps remain per-epoch failures.

overall_explanation: The implementation preserves denominators and separates optional response evidence, but strict-right cropping can admit deadline samples, header handling can hide resource interruptions, and timestamp parsing accepts malformed offsets. These defects affect the stated qualification and incomplete-replay guarantees. Review was read-only; tests were not run.
